newsitem.title: USA: Donaldson Lufkin says owns Column Financial.
newsitem.headline: Donaldson Lufkin says owns Column Financial.

text.p: Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette said on Tuesday that it had acquired the remaining 50 percent interest in Column Financial Corp from Equitable Cos Inc, bringing its ownership to 100 percent in the mortgage conduit financing company.
DLJ did not disclose terms of the transaction, but said Column Financial had acted as intermediary for more than $1 billion in mortgages.

"With the acquisition of the rest of Column Financial, we are better positioned to help increase the volume of business and expand the range of product offerings to Column's customers," said DLJ managing director Steven Kantor.
